name: launchproof-monorepo
description: LaunchProof — evidence-backed verification for AI-built applications.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchproof/core && npm run build -w @launchproof/browser && npm run build -w launchproof
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @launchproof/core && npm run typecheck -w @launchproof/browser && npm run typecheck -w launchproof && npm run typecheck -w @launchproof/web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:web
